verdict.rationale: The California Secretary of State is a government authority whose core product is the official state business registry and filing service (bizfile). Its value comes from the state's legal authority over the record, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution exists that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
